data.name: Eno
data.gender_notes: Eno is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Enoch was the seventh antediluvian patriarch, known for his close relationship with God. He was taken directly to heaven without experiencing death, a prefiguration of Elijah and Enoch. The name Eno carries the meaning “Man, mortal, human” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eno usually hope their child will grow to embody man, mortal, human and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of direct connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Eno belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, mortal, human.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eno total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Enoch has been passed down through generations, representing a strong biblical and historical background. It is not a common name, which adds to its uniqueness and might inspire curiosity and intrigue.

biblical_reference.note: Enoch was a man of great faith who walked with God. He was taken up to be with God before death.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Enoch, a biblical figure, and Eno, a variant of the name, are mentioned in the Book of Genesis. The name Eno carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Eno is associated with the biblical figure Enoch, who is said to have walked with God.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Eno remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Eno from Rome, Italy embodies the meaning of Eno - "Man, mortal, human". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
